title: CodeQualityReview
description: Given that the specification is accepted, is the implementation safe and maintainable? Runs only after spec compliance is clean, so it never re-argues what the task was supposed to do.

diff_hash.description: The diff this review was performed against. Required whenever the task has a diff_hash, which is every task that reached review with a captured diff; a review that omits it is rejected as REVIEW_NOT_BOUND_TO_A_DIFF, and one naming a different diff as REVIEW_NOT_BOUND_TO_CURRENT_DIFF. Not listed in `required` because a task with no diff -- an investigation or documentation task -- has no diff for its review to name.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete inputs/state leading to the wrong outcome. Required in spirit for BLOCKING correctness findings.

rule_id.description: Identifier of the deterministic rule that produced this finding, when a linter rather than a reviewer found it (e.g. NO_VAR_DECLARATION).

standards_audit.description: Written by the harness, not the reviewer: whether the deterministic coding-standards audit ran over this diff (RAN, DISABLED, NO_LINTABLE_FILES, SKIPPED, ERROR), how many files it read, which policy applied, and why it did not run. An audit that found nothing and an audit that never happened produce the same empty findings list; this is what tells them apart.

generated_by.description: Set when the document was synthesised by the harness rather than produced by a reviewer. A review carrying this is not a resolved review and the REVIEW gate refuses it.
